column1: # Purpose review of the theorems nothing references (formal/audit/
# unreferenced-theorems.md): for each, a person read the statement, the doc
# comment and the Rust it names, and checked the doc comment against the
# models' rule (formal/README.md, "How the models are written"): it says
# truthfully, and no more broadly than the statement, what the theorem
# guarantees about which Rust behaviour. Verdicts: keep; narrowed (kept, the
# doc comment narrowed to the statement); deleted (also in
# unreferenced theorem with no keep or narrowed row, and on a stale row. To
# review a new theorem: read it against the rule, fix or narrow its doc
# comment if needed, and add a row. Tab-separated: name, verdict, reason.
